summary: Conditional index setter. Copies the argument a2 into the result, then writes it into the dword at this+0x4 (this[1]) only when a2 is -1 or the entry tested at this[a2+29] is nonzero; otherwise this[1] is left unchanged. Always returns the original argument a2. Packet prelabel flags it as a structural twin of IntegerSetter (00406b30).

operations.description: Copy the argument a2 into the result value that will be returned.
Proceed with the store only when a2 is -1 (short-circuit) or the dword read at this[a2+29] is nonzero; otherwise leave this[1] untouched.
Write the argument a2 into the dword field at this+0x4 (this[1]).
Return the original argument a2 to the callers ConditionalSoundRenderDispatchOnParamCheck, PitStateUpdateMachine and LoadingPhase1.

unresolved: The meaning of the stored index at this+0x4 and of the guard array element this[a2+29] is unknown; the owning class is not established by the packet.
The condition semantics (why a2 == -1 bypasses the entry check) are not explained by the packet.
